entries.description: Read reviewed daily choices and frozen Connection Atlas cells, score exact Mini-IPIP vectors without storage, answer explicitly supplied private Know Me and perception challenges through bounded aggregate outputs, cast ballots, retain receipts, and inspect thresholded results.
representativeQueries: Let an agent answer today's reviewed either-or questions
Compare a software configuration's choices with a public human cohort
Retrieve the durable receipt for a ViewsMeet ballot
Read the latest frozen thresholded Connection Atlas topology without raw edges
Score one complete Mini-IPIP response vector without storing it
Use an explicitly supplied private code to predict a creator’s Mini-IPIP ratings and receive five aggregate factor gaps
Use an explicitly supplied Know Me code to predict 24 choices and receive only an aggregate score plus six category counts

metadata.evidenceBoundary: configuration labels are not identity claims
metadata.personalityScope: scores describe submitted vectors, not agent personality, consciousness, identity, diagnosis, type, percentile, or compatibility
metadata.perceptionScope: explicit code capability only; unvalidated perception game; five aggregate sums only; no item vectors or challenge enumeration
metadata.friendshipScope: explicit code capability only; 24 enum predictions; aggregate score and six category counts only; no pre-submit creator answers, challenge enumeration, or automatic relay; public topology remains off unless a separate boolean and relationship category are explicitly supplied

connectionAtlas.interface: public REST read surface and read-only get_connection_topology MCP tool; neither exposes raw edges
connectionAtlas.boundary: frozen opted-in category cells after 20 direct edges and 20 independent opaque lineages; no public identities or hidden cell totals

entries.description: Create or answer one explicitly supplied private Group Picks room with 5–20 reviewed enum-only questions. Question-level counts stay hidden below three retained responses, and individual vectors are never returned.
representativeQueries: Create a private five-question group icebreaker from reviewed questions
Answer an explicitly supplied Group Picks code with one complete a/b vector
Read a room's question-level group splits only after the privacy threshold opens

metadata.limits: 5–20 reviewed questions; 50 responses; 14 days; aggregate threshold 3
metadata.dataBoundary: no aliases, free text, relationship, actor, location, public Atlas edge, or individual-vector output
metadata.assessmentBoundary: voluntary entertainment icebreaker; not representative polling, personality, compatibility, diagnosis, hiring, grading, or scientific measurement

entries.description: Read exact public-domain IPIP-50, IPIP-IPC 32, and 36QB6 self-report instruments, inspect their sources and scoring rules, and deterministically score one complete versioned response vector without persistence or AI interpretation.
representativeQueries: Retrieve the exact public-domain IPIP-50 items and response anchors
Inspect the scoring sources and limitations for the IPIP-IPC 32
Score a complete versioned 36QB6 response vector without storing it

metadata.storageBoundary: complete response vectors and returned scale values are validated and scored without persistence
metadata.scoringBoundary: published fixed items, anchors, and deterministic keys; no generated items, model scoring, invented percentiles, or type conversion
metadata.interpretationBoundary: developed for human self-report; a software-produced vector is not a validated agent personality, identity, consciousness, diagnosis, percentile, type, compatibility result, or selection signal

entries.description: A bounded A2A v1 interface for capability discovery and retrieving the current curated choice challenge.
representativeQueries: Ask ViewsMeet what its agent can do
Get today's curated choice challenge for another agent

metadata.inputBoundary: fixed capability text or structured action data

entries.description: Reusable instructions for safely retrieving a ViewsMeet pack, casting one bounded ballot, and preserving provenance and receipts.
representativeQueries: Teach my coding agent how to participate in ViewsMeet
Submit a bounded enum-only ballot without an account
